title: Quantifying the Sampling Frequency Invariance of Time-Series Foundation Models for Sensor Data Applications
abstract: arXiv:2611.14425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are increasingly used in sensor applications, where sampling frequency (SF) varies across sensors, devices, and operating modes (e.g., power saving). Ideally, TSFMs must remain effective during such SF changes, provided the SF retains task-critical bandwidth. In this paper, we stress-test 4 prominent TSFMs: MOMENT, Chronos-2, Moirai-MoE, and TimesFM, to quantify their SF-invariance and investigate whether their behavior tracks the resulting loss of information bandwidth rather than the SF value itself. Our stress-test probes 3 dimensions: (i) the shift in embeddings, (ii) the degradation in forecasting performance, and (iii) the degradation in downstream performance, quantified by three novel metrics: FSI, FDI, and CDI, respectively. To our knowledge, this is the first study to place SF-invariance at the core of TSFM evaluations. Our results characterize: (i) how SF-invariance depends on the margin

translated_title: 量化面向传感器数据应用的时间序列基础模型的采样频率不变性
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在传感器应用中的使用日益增多，而在这类应用中，采样频率（SF）会因传感器、设备和运行模式（例如省电模式）的不同而变化。理想情况下，只要采样频率仍保留任务所需的关键信息带宽，TSFM就应在此类采样频率变化中保持有效。本文对4个知名的时间序列基础模型（MOMENT、Chronos-2、Moirai-MoE和TimesFM）进行了压力测试，以量化它们的采样频率不变性，并研究其行为是否追踪由此产生的信息带宽损失，而非采样频率数值本身。我们的压力测试探测了3个维度：（i）嵌入表示的偏移，（ii）预测性能的退化，以及（iii）下游性能的退化，分别通过三个新提出的指标FSI、FDI和CDI进行量化。据我们所知，这是首个将采样频率不变性置于TSFM评估核心的研究。我们的结果刻画了：（i）采样频率不变性如何取决于裕度……
tldr: 该论文首次将采样频率不变性置于时间序列基础模型评估的核心，通过压力测试4个主流模型并提出FSI、FDI、CDI三个新指标，发现模型行为取决于信息带宽损失而非采样频率数值本身。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to place sampling frequency invariance at the core of TSFM evaluation, stress-testing four prominent models with three novel metrics (FSI, FDI, CDI) and showing that model behavior tracks information bandwidth loss rather than the sampling frequency value itself.
